Kaiju Site Scope LLM context profile.

This pack keeps runtime source, tests, architecture docs, build/configuration, and registry compiler/provider code in full. Individual technology rule files under src/lib/detection/rules/<category>/ are intentionally omitted because they form a very large repetitive catalog. The rule layout README and top-level rules/index.ts remain included. For tasks that edit a specific detection rule, generate a task-specific pack with that rule/category included.
